name: Wipeout
description: An audio mangler locked to the song: fills, glitches, breaks, ratchets, rolls, timewarps, reverses and transitions. On a grid it rolls the dice and repeats a slice (1/4 to 1/32 and triplets), plays it backwards or at half speed, tape-stops it or gates it, with Roll, Vary, Hold and a pattern lock for playing live on the Q-Links.
author: Groundswell
